leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Import the useMemo hook from React to access memoization functionality.
Define a computationally expensive function that performs complex calculations.
Apply the useMemo hook to wrap the expensive calculation function.
Construct a dependency array to specify when the memoized value should be recalculated.
Store the memoized result in a variable for reuse across renders.
Utilize the memoized value within JSX to display calculated results.
Modify state variables to trigger re-renders and test memoization behavior.
Compare performance between memoized and non-memoized implementations.
Control when expensive computations execute by adjusting dependency arrays.
Implement conditional logic to demonstrate when useMemo prevents unnecessary recalculations.
Return memoized values from custom hooks to share optimized calculations across components.
Execute side-by-side comparisons to validate that useMemo prevents redundant work.
